{
  "statusCode" : 0,
  "message" : "",
  "returnObj" : "harbor: "{registry_url}"    # ip:port
masterVip: ""
enableGlobal: false
isManagedCluster: false

tolerations:
  - effect: "NoExecute"
    key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/master"
    operator: "Exists"
  - effect: "NoSchedule"
    key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/master"
    operator: "Exists"
  - effect: "NoExecute"
    key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane"
    operator: "Exists"
  - effect: "NoSchedule"
    key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane"
    operator: "Exists"

#relabel_configs:
#  - replacement: bar
#    target_label: foo
#    action: replace

globalConfig:
  scrapeInterval: 1m
  scrapeTimeout: 10s

otelCollector:
  enabled: true
  imageTag: "0.61.0"
  resources:
    requests:
      memory: 100Mi
      cpu: 100m
    limits:
      memory: 4Gi
      cpu: 3
  clusterName: "{cluster_name}"
  armsGateway: "{arms_gateway}"
  armsLicense: "{arms_license}"
  tenantCode: "{tenant_code}"
  tenantId: "{tenant_id}"
  tenantName: "{tenant_name}"
  regionCode: "{region}"
  regionName: "{region_name}"
  instanceId: "{instance_id}"

prometheus-node-exporter:
  ## If false, node-exporter will not be installed
  ##
  enabled: true
  image:
    repository: "{registry_url}"
